historical_growth.growth_rate_source: H1 2026 revenue run-rate (+6.3%) and FY2025 (+7.1%); managed GFA +11.2% in FY2025 but per-sq.m. mix shift to non-residential and 9.6% terminations dilute conversion to revenue
historical_growth.growth_divergence_warning: Equity CAGR (3.1-3.8%) diverges >30% from revenue (8.8-13.7%) and 3yr EPS (18.1%): payout (dividends RMB573m + buybacks RMB121m in FY2025 = ~79% of attributable profit) holds book value nearly flat, so equity CAGR understates the business's growth. Not used as the base growth anchor.
historical_growth.notes: Owner-FCF series (reported FCF - SBC - interest income): FY2020 861.9, FY2021 470.8, FY2022 153.8, FY2023 823.2, FY2024 1,041.2, FY2025 1,299.4. The 3yr CAGRs are off the FY2022 trough (working-capital squeeze during the developer liquidity crisis) and are not a trend; the 5yr owner CAGR of 8.6% exceeds reported 7.8% because interest income has grown slower than FCF and SBC has shrunk (RMB57m -> RMB20m). Capex fell from 2.9% of revenue (FY2023) to 0.63% (FY2025) partly on the MAG childcare disposal; the forward build does not carry the FY2025 low forward.

scenario_narratives.base: China's property-management leader in high-end residential keeps growing managed GFA mid-single digits net of ~9% terminations, revenue +6.5% fading to 3%, adjusted EBITDA margin edging from 8.75% to 9.5% as 'Deep Service' cost discipline and operating leverage offset labour inflation while expected credit losses stay elevated near 2.5% of revenue; capex and D&A converge at 1% of revenue; dividends and buybacks absorb most of the owner FCF with the RMB6.4bn cash pile intact.
scenario_narratives.bull: Urban-renewal district contracts and the non-residential pivot sustain high-single-digit growth through Y5, developer receivables are provisioned through so ECL normalises, AI-enabled service delivery lifts adjusted EBITDA to 10.5%, VAS re-accelerates and the effective tax rate settles at the H1 2026 run-rate of 28%.
scenario_narratives.bear: The developer and local-government liquidity squeeze keeps terminations above 10% of GFA, consulting keeps shrinking, VAS stays flat and receivables keep absorbing cash; wage inflation on a 14% gross-margin core compresses adjusted EBITDA to 7.5% and growth fades to 2%, leaving value resting largely on the net cash and a 7.5%-margin fee stream.

valuation_philosophy.summary: A recurring, fee-based service business valued on owner FCF after expensing SBC, the full lease cash cost and the expected credit losses the China property cycle imposes, discounted in RMB at a 9% cost of equity and converted to HKD only at the end. Net cash of RMB6.4bn (time deposits included, restricted balances and wealth-management products excluded) is about 1.7 HKD/share of the value; interest income is stripped from the flows so that cash is not counted twice. Associates/JVs are added and minorities deducted at book, each once. The 15x terminal cap binds slightly in the base case, so the valuation does not rest on Gordon growth. The RMB1.35bn accrued-tax liability (three years of charge, unpaid) is deducted beyond one normal year as debt-like. The market at the valuation-date price capitalises the business at roughly 3-4x EV/owner-FCF and ~12x P/E -- the sector-wide discount applied to Chinese property managers (cash seen as trapped or at risk, developer receivables, parent-developer association); the gap to the house value is that discount, which the bear case (7.5% margin, 2% growth, negative working capital) only partly closes.
key_risks_to_valuation: Market applies a structural discount to Chinese property managers' net cash (RMB6.4bn here, ~HK$2.4/share) -- if cash is lent to or trapped with affiliates, or receivables (RMB7.4bn gross at 30 Jun 2026) prove uncollectible, the bridge overstates value
Expected credit losses on developer and local-government receivables (RMB532m in FY2025) could keep rising; each 1pp of revenue in ECL is ~0.7pp of owner-FCF margin
Terminations at 9.6% of managed GFA and rising -- the base case assumes they stabilise, not reverse
Property-management fee regulation by local governments caps pricing on the 71%-of-revenue residential core while labour costs (RMB6.2bn, +7.1%) are rigid
Cash tax has lagged the P&L charge (current tax liability RMB1.35bn); a catch-up payment would hit a year's FCF
CNY/HKD translation: the quote-currency IV moves one-for-one with the rate (1.175 at valuation)
Regional concentration: Hangzhou + Yangtze River Delta ~68% of revenue

inputs.fx_note: CNY->HKD 1.175 (Yahoo CNYHKD=X, 2026-10-22T06:05Z); parity check USDHKD 7.8453 / USDCNY 6.6739 = 1.1755. Statements and all flows in RMB (filings in RMB thousands, stored in millions); HKEX quote in HKD. Per-share values computed in RMB and multiplied by 1.175 for the quote-currency IV. No dual listing to parity-check the share price.
inputs.wacc_rationale: Built in CNY, the currency of the flows: China 10y CGB ~1.8% (Oct 2026) + beta ~1.1 x China ERP ~6.5% = cost of equity ~9.0%; bank debt is RMB39m against RMB6.4bn of cash, so WACC = cost of equity = 9.0%. Same WACC in all three scenarios: cyclicality, receivables stress and the property-developer exposure are charged in the scenario flows and weights, not stacked into the rate.
inputs.lease_treatment: (B) leases as operating cost: full lease cash (FY2025 capital element 110.8 + interest element 20.1 = RMB130.9m, 0.68% of revenue) charged inside adjusted EBITDA via lease_cost_pct_path; lease liabilities (RMB223.6m at 30 Jun 2026) EXCLUDED from net debt. da_pct_path is D&A ex right-of-use depreciation (FY2025: PPE 130.0 + investment property 54.3 + intangibles 58.4 = RMB242.7m, 1.27% of revenue; RoU depreciation 134.1 excluded) so the lease is charged once and cash-tax EBIT is not double-hit.
inputs.nci_treatment: Flows are consolidated; non-controlling interests deducted once in the equity bridge at book value (RMB761.5m at 30 Jun 2026; NCI took 6.4% of FY2025 profit, RMB60.7m, so book ~12.5x NCI earnings is a fair proxy). Associates and JVs (book RMB1,090.2m) are ADDED in the bridge because their share of profit (RMB44.9m FY2025) sits below operating profit and is not in the EBITDA driver.
inputs.notes: Model: owner-FCF component DCF (operating services company, fee-based recurring revenue, net cash, no fair-value or deposit funding issues; routed via dcf-methods SKILL.md row 2 'operating company, non-US' with the adaptations file: currency CNY/HKD, leases (B), NCI, excluded-income matching asset, risk charged once). Greentown Service is a property-management company (NOT a toll-road operator; see memory note). FY0 = FY2025 (Dec year-end); Y1 = FY2026, of which H1 is reported (revenue +6.3%, attributable profit +15.1%, GM 19.9% vs 19.5%). Adjusted EBITDA FY2025 = profit from operations 1,280.7 + D&A 376.8 + SBC 19.8 = RMB1,677.3m, 8.75% of revenue, AFTER expected credit losses of RMB531.9m (2.8% of revenue, up from 1.3%) -- ECL is kept inside the margin as a real cost of this business. Cash tax: P&L effective rate 32.1% FY2025, 29.8% FY2024, 28.7% H1 2026; cash paid was only 23% of PBT because the current-tax liability keeps growing (RMB1,350m at 30 Jun 2026), which is not assumed to persist -- base uses 30%. Owner FCF after lease cash (treatment B) is RMB1,168.5m; last_fcf follows the contract definition (reported - SBC - interest income = 1,299.4). Price is an intraday HKEX print, not a close; replace at the next regular close if it moved. No formal numerical guidance is published; FY2026 year-1 growth is anchored on the H1 2026 run-rate.

bear.narrative: Prolonged China property downturn: terminations rise past 10% of managed GFA, consulting/property-under-construction revenue keeps shrinking, VAS stays stalled, revenue growth fades to 2%; wage inflation on the 14% gross-margin core plus ECL staying at ~3% of revenue compress adjusted EBITDA to 7.5%; receivables from developers and local governments keep consuming working capital (negative capture); tax stays 32% on non-deductible provisions. Terminal growth 2.0%. The RMB6.4bn net cash is the floor under this case.

base.narrative: Revenue +6.5% in FY2026 (H1 +6.3%) decelerating to 3% by Y8 as managed-GFA growth slows, terminations stay ~8-10% of GFA and consulting stays flat; adjusted EBITDA margin 8.75% -> 9.5% by Y5 from the 'Deep Service' cost discipline and operating leverage already visible in H1 2026 (GM +0.4pp), with ECL staying elevated at ~2.5% of revenue; cash tax 30%; capex normalising to 1.0% = D&A ex-RoU; working capital captures 5% of revenue growth (contract liabilities and payables growth slightly ahead of receivables build). Terminal cap of 15x binds marginally against Gordon at 9%/2.5% (15.8x).

bull.narrative: Urban-renewal / stock-renewal district contracts (15th Five-Year Plan naming property management; Hangzhou Cuiyuan, Tonglu Henggang) plus non-residential wins lift growth to 8.5% and keep it above 6% through Y5; ECL normalises back toward 1.5% of revenue as developer receivables are provisioned through, AI/robot service delivery and the H1 2026 margin trend take adjusted EBITDA to 10.5%; community-living VAS re-accelerates; effective tax eases to 28% (H1 2026 run-rate) as non-deductible provisions fall. Terminal growth 3.0%.

required_return_table.note: Each row rebuilds the terminal value at that row's rate (max(0, min(Gordon@r, 15x FCF_N))); the WACC row is valuation.base.intrinsic_value and the hurdle row is entry_price.base.entry_price.

sensitivity.note: Rows are WACC, columns terminal growth; each cell rebuilds its own terminal value.

probability_weighted.weights_rationale: Bear raised from the 15% default to 25%: the China property downturn is in its fifth year, expected credit losses doubled in FY2025 (RMB532m, 2.8% of revenue), terminations have tripled since 2021 to 9.6% of managed GFA, and 68% of revenue is concentrated in the Yangtze River Delta. Bull held at 25% rather than 35% because it needs three independent things -- ECL normalisation, urban-renewal contract conversion at scale, and a VAS re-acceleration -- to happen together; the H1 2026 margin expansion gives it credibility but not a majority. Base 50%.
probability_weighted.band_note: House/street band has collapsed: SBC is 0.1% of revenue (RMB20m), so house and street IV differ by ~HK$0.13 and the computed band_position is meaningless (price sits far below both). Read it as n/a, not as a -4,000% reading.

sanity_check.basis: SBC-adjusted on both sides (EPS less SBC/share; EBITDA less SBC), so these deliberately do not match GAAP screener multiples.
